messages:
maria (Marketing): quick sync — we're aiming to announce the release this Friday morning PT. need final changelog link, docs URL, and a one-sentence note about model compatibility for the blog/threads. can eng confirm rollout window?
aj (Engineering): changelog is at PR #452, i'll add a short compat note for quantized variants by EOD. target canary start 2h before public announce, fallback to smaller model if perf regresses.
elaine (Eng Release): canary window looks ok. propose canary = 7am PT, public = 11am PT. release runbook updated — i'll paste the critical snippet below.
elaine (Eng Release): ```
# release snippet
deploy_release --canary --canary-duration=4h --public-after=11amPT --tag=stable-2026-03
# rollback: deploy_rollback --to-tag=stable-2026-02
```
sam (Docs): i'll publish the docs page and perms by midnight. url will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/452 (placeholder). i'll also attach the changelog anchor.
tim (Product): benchmark narrative — marketing needs one short paragraph on latency/cost improvements + one chart. eng, can we confirm N-token p50/p99 and %cost reduction vs previous baseline?
aj (Engineering): will export the benchmark csv and a 1-paragraph summary. p50 down ~18%, p99 down ~9% on our internal gen workload. cost/unit roughly -22% with batching + quant config. csv link: `s3://ci-artifacts/benchmarks/release-452.csv`
nina (Growth): planning a short webinar next week — need slide 1 with changelog highlights and 1 slide with ops checklist. maria i'll coordinate speakers.
maria (Marketing): thanks — we'll draft the blog + social copy after we get final changelog link + the one-sentence compat line. Sam, when the docs URL is fixed can you post it here? also need an SEO-friendly title suggestion.
sam (Docs): docs url now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v452 — changelog anchor: #changelog. added compat note: "Quantized variants currently supported for <8k context; see migration notes."
elaine (Eng Release): confirmed cadence in runbook. small ask: marketing please avoid promising global GA before we've verified canary telemetry for 2h. we'll share canary dashboard link once started.
maria (Marketing): understood. we'll say "staged rollout, starting with canary" and call out ETA for full rollout. nina i'll hold webinar promo until canary ok.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for tag stable-2026-03 at 1982345698. monitoring: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary/452
aj (Engineering): seeing nominal token throughput, will watch p99. will post a summary once 30m of telemetry looks stable.
maria (Marketing): perfect — once aj confirms post-30m, i'll finalize the announcement copy and post the blog + social at public time. thanks everyone :rocket:
